opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Ordinarily resident in the United Kingdom; hold a current long‑term appointment at a UK Higher Education Institution or Independent Research Organisation; pursue original independent research within the Humanities or Social Sciences; independent researchers without institutional affiliation are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Awards to support UK‑based researchers to develop quantitative, data‑science, digital humanities or language skills, fostering interdisciplinary approaches and skill development.

opportunities.title: APEX Awards

amount.raw: up to £200,000 (plus up to £10,000 public engagement)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researcher with a permanent or fixed‑term position at a UK university or not‑for‑profit research organisation; must have teaching and administrative duties; lead applicant must be UK‑based; co‑applicants must be from a different Academy remit.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for established researchers to pursue interdisciplinary, curiosity‑driven projects across the humanities, social sciences, science, engineering and technology.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any UK‑based researcher across career stages; must have prior public engagement experience; previous award holders cannot reapply.
opportunities.summary: Funding for public engagement projects with GLAM or performing arts partners, providing up to £8,000 for direct project costs.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in humanities or social sciences based at a UK university or recognised research organisation; British or EEA nationals; must have completed viva between 1 Apr 2024 and 1 Apr 2027; cannot hold a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowships supporting independent research leading to a publishable output, funded on an 80 % FEC basis.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based principal investigator in humanities or social sciences, post‑doctoral or above, with at least 20 % FTE on award; must involve overseas co‑applicants; PI must hold an established role at a UK university or research institute.
opportunities.summary: Two‑year interdisciplinary projects on mobilities, led by UK researchers with international partners, offering up to £300,000 of funding.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based early‑ or mid‑career researchers in humanities or social sciences, based at a UK university or research organisation.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowships hosted at DGAP in Berlin, supporting policy‑relevant research and sector engagement, with up to £150,000 funding.

opportunities.title: Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027 (British Academy & Alexander von Humboldt Foundation)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers affiliated with UK or German research institutions.
opportunities.summary: Funding to attend a three‑day symposium on ‘Humans and Nature’, covering travel, accommodation and seed funding for collaborative projects.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants intending to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support specific additional needs such as equipment, caring costs or assistance with application preparation.
